# OpenVidu

> Self-hosted video conferencing and custom WebRTC solutions: deploy OpenVidu Meet in minutes or build with OpenVidu Platform SDKs. Open source and scalable.

Self-hosted videoconference solution and SDK

## OpenVidu Meet

- [OpenVidu Meet](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/index.md): OpenVidu Meet - Ready to use videoconferencing solution
- [Releases](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/releases/index.md): OpenVidu Meet - Release notes
- [Getting started with OpenVidu Meet](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/getting-started/index.md): OpenVidu Meet - Getting started
- [Overview](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/features/overview/index.md): OpenVidu Meet Features - A global picture of all OpenVidu Meet features
- [Overview](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/features/rooms/overview/index.md): OpenVidu Meet Features - What a room is and its key principles
- [Creation & Management](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/features/rooms/management/index.md): OpenVidu Meet Features - Create, edit, list and delete rooms, configure auto-deletion and room appearance
- [Room Access](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/features/rooms/access/index.md): OpenVidu Meet Features - Anonymous access, external members, registered members and predefined roles
- [Overview](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/features/meetings/overview/index.md): OpenVidu Meet Features - What a meeting is and how to join
- [Meeting lifecycle](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/features/meetings/lifecycle/index.md): OpenVidu Meet Features - Meeting lifecycle (Join, Device, Meeting, Recording and End views)
- [Live Captions](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/features/meetings/live-captions/index.md): OpenVidu Meet Features - Enable and use live captions in a meeting
- [Smart Layout](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/features/meetings/smart-layout/index.md): OpenVidu Meet Features - Smart adaptive layout in meetings
- [Role Management](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/features/meetings/role-management/index.md): OpenVidu Meet Features - Promote and demote participants between Moderator and Speaker during a meeting
- [E2E Encryption](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/features/meetings/e2e-encryption/index.md): OpenVidu Meet Features - End-to-end encryption for meetings
- [Virtual Background](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/features/meetings/virtual-background/index.md): OpenVidu Meet Features - Virtual background for participants
- [Overview](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/features/users/overview/index.md): OpenVidu Meet Features - Registered users, roles and the root administrator
- [Creation & Management](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/features/users/management/index.md): OpenVidu Meet Features - Create, list and delete users with the Users API and change credentials
- [Overview](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/features/room-members/overview/index.md): OpenVidu Meet Features - External and registered room members
- [Creation & Management](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/features/room-members/management/index.md): OpenVidu Meet Features - Add, list, update and remove room members with the Room Members API
- [Overview](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/features/recordings/overview/index.md): OpenVidu Meet Features - Overview of recordings
- [Creation & Management](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/features/recordings/management/index.md): OpenVidu Meet Features - Start, list, share, download and delete recordings
- [Recording configuration](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/features/recordings/configuration/index.md): OpenVidu Meet Features - Recording layouts and resolution
- [Overview](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/deployment/overview/index.md): A comparison of different deployment models for OpenVidu Meet
- [Try OpenVidu Meet locally](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/deployment/local/index.md): How to deploy OpenVidu Meet locally for testing and development purposes
- [Basic deployment](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/deployment/basic/index.md): How to deploy OpenVidu Meet on-premises within a single server for production use
- [Advanced deployments](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/deployment/advanced/index.md): How to deploy OpenVidu Meet on multiple servers with scalability and fault-tolerance for production use
- [Introduction](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/embedded/intro/index.md): How to embed OpenVidu Meet in my own application with a single line of HTML
- [Step by step guide](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/embedded/step-by-step-guide/index.md): A step by step guide on how to embed OpenVidu Meet on your own applications
- [Deploy your application](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/embedded/deploy-your-app/index.md): How to deploy your own application that embeds OpenVidu Meet
- [OpenVidu Meet Tutorials](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/embedded/tutorials/index.md): A list of tutorials for embedding OpenVidu Meet in your own applications
- [Direct Link](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/embedded/tutorials/embedding-options/direct-link/index.md): An OpenVidu Meet tutorial for embedding OpenVidu Meet on a Node.js applications using a direct link. It uses Node.js and Express for the backend and plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript for the frontend.
- [WebComponent](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/embedded/tutorials/embedding-options/webcomponent/index.md): An OpenVidu Meet tutorial for embedding OpenVidu Meet using the OpenVidu Meet WebComponent. It uses Node.js and Express for the backend and plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript for the frontend.
- [WebComponent Commands & Events](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/embedded/tutorials/embedding-options/webcomponent-advanced/index.md): An OpenVidu Meet WebComponent tutorial demonstrating how to use the OpenVidu Meet Component programmatically and respond to meeting events. It includes usage of features of OpenVidu Meet such as WebComponent commands, event handling, role-based UI, meeting header, and enhanced room management.
- [Anonymous Access](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/embedded/tutorials/access/anonymous-access/index.md): An OpenVidu Meet tutorial showing how individuals can join a room through anonymous access links (moderator or speaker). It uses Node.js and Express for the backend and plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript for the frontend.
- [Identified Guests](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/embedded/tutorials/access/identified-guests/index.md): An OpenVidu Meet tutorial showing how to add identified guests with a fixed name and a unique access link to a room. It uses Node.js and Express for the backend and plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript for the frontend.
- [Users](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/embedded/tutorials/access/users/index.md): An OpenVidu Meet tutorial showing how to create users with the Users API and add them to a room as members. It uses Node.js and Express for the backend and plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript for the frontend.
- [Recordings](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/embedded/tutorials/advanced-features/recordings/index.md): How to add recording management capabilities to an OpenVidu Meet WebComponent application. It includes listing recordings, viewing recordings and deleting recordings.
- [Webhooks](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/embedded/tutorials/advanced-features/webhooks/index.md): Learn how to build a real-time video conferencing application using Node.js and JavaScript with live updates through webhooks and Server-Sent Events.
- [Direct Link](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/embedded/reference/direct-link/index.md): OpenVidu Meet - Reference documentation
- [Iframe](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/embedded/reference/iframe/index.md): OpenVidu Meet - Reference documentation
- [REST API](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/embedded/reference/rest-api/index.md): OpenVidu Meet - Reference documentation
- [Webcomponent](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/embedded/reference/webcomponent/index.md): OpenVidu Meet - Reference documentation
- [Webhooks](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/embedded/reference/webhooks/index.md): OpenVidu Meet - Reference documentation

## OpenVidu Platform

- [OpenVidu Platform](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/index.md): OpenVidu Platform - Self-hosted SDK to build scalable videoconferencing solutions
- [Releases](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/releases/index.md): OpenVidu Platform - Release notes
- [Getting started](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/getting-started/index.md): OpenVidu Platform - Getting started
- [Comparing OpenVidu](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/comparing-openvidu/index.md): OpenVidu Platform - Comparing OpenVidu Meet and OpenVidu Platform with other solutions like LiveKit Cloud and Mediasoup
- [Developing your OpenVidu app](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/developing-your-openvidu-app/index.md): OpenVidu Platform - Steps involved in building an OpenVidu videoconferencing application.
- [How to](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/developing-your-openvidu-app/how-to/index.md): OpenVidu Platform - Quick reference of the most common operations you may want to perform in your application while integrating OpenVidu Platform.
- [Advanced Features Tutorials](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/tutorials/advanced-features/index.md): Explore more advanced features of LiveKit with our tutorials on recording, S3, Azure, and more.
- [AI Services Tutorials](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/tutorials/ai-services/index.md): Learn how to integrate AI services in your OpenVidu applications.
- [Angular Components Tutorials](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/tutorials/angular-components/index.md): Learn how to customize your application UI with Angular Components tutorials. Custom layouts, toolbars, panels, chat and more.
- [Application Client Tutorials](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/tutorials/application-client/index.md): Learn how to build a LiveKit application client to connect to a room, publish media and subscribe to media from other participants.
- [Application Server Tutorials](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/tutorials/application-server/index.md): Learn how to build an application server that generates LiveKit tokens and receives webhook events.
- [Deployment types](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/self-hosting/deployment-types/index.md): Description of the different OpenVidu Platform user-friendly installers that facilitate quick on-premises deployments, so you can self-host your real-time solution in your own infrastructure or any cloud provider.
- [Local (Development)](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/self-hosting/local/index.md): Easy local install deployment instructions for testing and development purposes.
- [OpenVidu Single Node Community](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/self-hosting/single-node/index.md): Different options for a single node deployment, be it on-premises or on any of the most popular cloud providers such as AWS, Azure or GCP.
- [OpenVidu Single Node Pro](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/self-hosting/single-node-pro/index.md): The features of Single Node OpenVidu with a 2x performance and advanced observability.
- [OpenVidu Elastic](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/self-hosting/elastic/index.md): Elastic deployment options for OpenVidu Platform, either on-premises, on AWS, or on Azure.
- [OpenVidu High Availability](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/self-hosting/ha/index.md): High Availability deployment options for OpenVidu Platform, either on-premises (with DNS or network load balancers), on AWS, or on Azure.
- [Production ready](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/self-hosting/production-ready/index.md): Main advantages of self-hosting videoconferencing and live-streaming solutions with OpenVidu Platform, which are privacy, leverage your resources, performant, scalable, fault tolerant, and observable.
- [Performant](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/self-hosting/production-ready/performance/index.md): OpenVidu Platform 2x performance by using mediasoup to replace the original Pion LiveKit WebRTC engine while maintaining the LiveKit API.
- [Scalable](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/self-hosting/production-ready/scalability/index.md): OpenVidu Platform scalability numbers and Elastic and High Availability deployments.
- [Fault Tolerant](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/self-hosting/production-ready/fault-tolerance/index.md): OpenVidu is designed from the ground up to be fault tolerant in all its services in case of node downtime, especially in its High Availability deployment.
- [Observability](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/self-hosting/production-ready/observability/index.md): A description of OpenVidu's observability toolset to monitor and analyze your deployment in real-time, consisting of OpenVidu Dashboard and a Grafana stack.
- [OpenVidu Dashboard](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/self-hosting/production-ready/observability/openvidu-dashboard/index.md): How to access real-time video room statistics and monitoring with OpenVidu Dashboard. Track rooms, participants, egresses and ingresses.
- [Grafana Stack](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/self-hosting/production-ready/observability/grafana-stack/index.md): How to use OpenVidu's built-in Grafana dashboards to monitor different metrics from OpenVidu Platform and logs from your cluster.
- [How To Guides](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/self-hosting/how-to-guides/index.md): Explore step-by-step guides to customize your OpenVidu deployment for specific use cases.
- [Overview](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/ai/overview/index.md): OpenVidu offers a catalog of AI services that can be easily integrated into your application to enhance the user experience and add advanced features. These services are provided by OpenVidu agents, a set of pre-configured and ready-to-use AI modules.
- [Overview](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/ai/openvidu-agents/overview/index.md): A description of how to use and configure OpenVidu Agents, pre-configured and ready-to-use AI modules.
- [Speech Processing agent](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/ai/openvidu-agents/speech-processing-agent/index.md): Instructions on how to configure the Speech Processing OpenVidu agent which transcribes audio speech to text in real time.
- [Angular Components](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/ui-components/angular-components/index.md): OpenVidu Angular Components simplify the creation of videoconferencing apps, offering customizable and powerful components for rapid development and easy maintenance. This is a how-to guide on using this angular library.
- [React Components](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/ui-components/react-components/index.md): the simplest way to create real-time audio/video applications with React.
